documents.name: Delos Archaeological Site
documents.summary: An uninhabited archaeological island where sanctuaries, houses, commercial quarters, mosaics and terraces survive within the original Aegean landscape.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Few archaeological sites preserve such strong separation from the modern world; the island journey and exposed ancient city create exceptional historical atmosphere.

booking.note: Plan around ferry departures and weather; access is boat-dependent.

coreExperience.note: Understanding interpretation materially improves an otherwise ruin-led visit.

ferry.label: Plan around ferry and weather conditions
ferry.note: The archaeological visit is inseparable from boat access.

sun.label: Bring water and strong sun protection
sun.note: The site is exposed with very little shade.

coverImage.alt: Ancient stone remains at the Delos archaeological site in the Cyclades

documents.name: Watercity Waterpark Crete
documents.summary: Watercity Waterpark Crete is a water park destination in Anopolis, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A large, terrain-integrated water park with enough variety to justify a dedicated family day in Crete.

audience.notes: Editorial destination-fit profile derived from the researched positive age span. Bands without positive evidence remain unknown rather than being treated as a positive match or a hard prohibition. Individual rides and activities may have stricter operator rules.
